title: Stamphog fake GitHub must return node_id on dismissal and record GraphQL minimize
answers: Why does the stamphog fake GitHub need node_id in the dismissal response?
How do I assert a stamphog review was hidden as outdated in tests?
Adding a new GraphQL call to stamphog test fakes
body:
Client behavior and the fake GitHub in `products/stamphog/backend/tests/fakes.py` change together.
- `dismiss_pr_review` reads `node_id` from the dismissal response, so `fakes.py:_dismiss_review` must return `node_id` (`PRR_<id>`); otherwise the hide is silently skipped.
- `fakes.py:_graphql` routes by query shape and records `{kind: 'minimize_review', node_id, query}` in `github_writes` for `minimizeComment`. Any new GraphQL caller needs its own branch there.
- `test_integration.py` asserts via `github_writes` (e.g. `test_failed_run_still_dismisses_the_stale_approval_first` checks `classifier: OUTDATED`).
- Also update `products/stamphog/README.md` when retraction behavior changes.
applies: stamphog tests and client GraphQL/dismissal changes
